measurement.timing_end: First CRC-checked native 320x320 frame with all eight ranks, e2-e3, your-turn and the footer
measurement.canonical_projection: Unscaled pixel translation: Pico FMK cell origin (8,36) to Classic (2,0); only the existing 16x16 disk-activity mask is ignored

historical_reference.caveat: Historical Classic measurements used continuous USB Screen and cached compiled images. This is an end-to-end configuration comparison, not an isolated MCU speed benchmark.

known_findings: Between BASIC parts Screen::render draws the generic MK61S header and separator before the retained M61 native bitmap. Zero bits do not erase the header, producing the observed flicker.
Each changed LCD image transfers the full 204800-byte RGB565 frame at 8928571 Hz; the payload alone takes about 0.1835 seconds.
PicoCalc run_document compiles each BASIC part again; it does not use the Classic compiled-image cache.

An isolated host correction for the M61 display ownership passes the exact native-frame regression and Pico ASan/UBSan suite. It was not installed: the user explicitly selected completing the original-firmware measurement.
limits: One completed hardware run, not a statistical series.
USB Screen was detached during computation; attaching and verifying the final native frame is included separately in the measured endpoint.
The benchmark searches the initial position at level 2, maximum depth 8; it is not a complete game.
